---
title: URL image mediabag handling
format: typst
keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        # The downloaded image must use mediabag and retain its alt text.
        - ['image\("url-image-mediabag_files(/|\\\\)mediabag(/|\\\\)400[^"]*",\s*alt:\s*"A 400x400 placeholder image"']
        # The original remote URL must not remain in Typst output.
        - ['https://placehold\.co/400']
---

# URL Image Test

This tests that URL images are correctly extracted to the mediabag
when rendering to Typst format. The image below should be fetched
from the URL and stored locally with its alt text, not left as a raw URL.

![Placeholder image from URL](https://placehold.co/400){alt="A 400x400 placeholder image"}
